items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: And one of the policemen there, his name was Smitherman

ctx.x: Well, the whites got this message and they let themselves in these Negroes' homes and left them in their beds, dead. They stationed themselves under these boilers and as they ran out of their house, they'd shoot them down. And they all ended up walking out of town to a picnic grounds, called Jenks. And they had them all rounded up out there. And they would tie them up and whip them, some of them that had been bad actors before, you know, that they had it in for.
And one of the policemen there, his name was Smitherman -- well, this happened before he was a policeman, they cut off one of his ears and made him eat it, and say, "Isn't

that good?" And said, "Yes." They cut another one's privates off, made him eat it. He hemorrhaged to death, naturally. Another one, they -- what's the word? Castrated, and made him eat his balls, his testicles, you know?
